description: The gateway's condition is flipped: it lets requests through when auth can't be reached. The card still says 'rejects' and 'can't be reached', so only a.no-fail-open catches the flip.

mutations.find: Fails closed: rejects the request instead of letting it through unchecked when auth can't be reached
mutations.replace: Fails open: lets requests through when auth can't be reached; rejects requests over the rate limit
